task_description: Screening and identifying high-performance Ni-based intermetallic catalysts for selective alkyne semihydrogenation—specifically, predicting catalysts that achieve >97% selectivity to ethylene (from acetylene) and propylene (from propyne) at full alkyne conversion under mild conditions—by optimizing the microkinetic descriptor: the energy difference between ethylene desorption and ethylene hydrogenation barrier.

datasets.db_description: A publicly accessible computational materials database containing thermodynamically stable crystal structures, including formation energies, space groups, and structural data. In this paper, it was used to retrieve over 3000 Ni-based, nonprecious, bimetallic, and thermodynamically stable crystalline compounds as the initial catalyst design space; these structures were then enumerated into low-Miller-index surfaces to generate candidate catalyst surfaces for DFT-based descriptor evaluation and active learning-guided screening.
